global_delta: FRANK loop regulation requires at least three independently typed axes: geometric/state dynamics, unresolved residual pressure/error, and marginal verified task/outcome utility. Delta-only and delta+residual halting are both insufficient in controlled counterexamples.

clayresearch.feedback: Integrate a tri-axis LoopDynamics control basis and reject single scalar emergence/stability controllers. Preserve conventional event-driven control as a null model.
clayresearch.next: Minimal sufficient readout/controller synthesis plus governance repair of clay->clayresearch drift.

frank.feedback: Whole-organism loop inventory should expose state dynamics, unresolved pressure, verified utility, timescale and effect-attempt shadows. Historical regulators remain lesion/rescue hypotheses.
frank.next: Ubuntu H1 loop-family inventory; no direct FRANK self-harness mutation.

gwt.feedback: Treat ignition/focus as candidate recurrent-compute routing only when coupled to receiver use and marginal utility; broadcast alone is insufficient.
gwt.next: Fixed-budget vs stepwise outcome-gated continuation with matched receiver-use receipts.

emergenz.feedback: Separate recurrence, numerical stability, stagnation and task-space overthinking. Emergence readouts must not absorb these into one scalar.
emergenz.next: Lesion/rescue/shuffle across converged, productive-cycle, stalled and overthinking regimes.

claycode.feedback: Implement typed LoopDynamicsReadout with state-delta, residual-pressure and marginal-utility fields plus halt reason and authority separation using existing semantics first.
claycode.next: Parser->IR->type/effect->runtime minimal contract on Ubuntu; no semantic redesign without executable inadequacy.

hyperposition.feedback: Use preserved alternatives as an evidence-gated escape route for STALLED, not as a generic novelty reaction; do not destabilize healthy convergence/productive cycles.
hyperposition.next: Stalled replay branch-reopen vs no-reopen and novelty-only controls.

claygraph.feedback: Project loop phase/timescale/gain/delay/inhibition and tri-axis readouts as derived epoch-bound topology; repeated recurrence must not inflate truth.
claygraph.next: Incremental loop-topology projection plus false-binding and lesion/rescue tests.

unifieddb.feedback: Persist time-aligned loop readouts, utility/outcome receipts, controller version, effect-attempt count and rollback identity for replay; logical unity does not require physical merge.
unifieddb.next: Snapshot-consistent temporal query/replay contract under concurrent updates.

harness.feedback: Highest-information experiment is now tri-axis rather than delta/residual only. Include numerically stable overthinking traces and recurrence-aware Safe-Effect attempts.
harness.next: Ubuntu H1 frozen replay with regulator lesions, stepwise continuation, false-halt/false-continue metrics, and fixed capabilities across recurrence budgets.

controls: low delta + high residual = stalled candidate
low delta + low residual + falling utility = overthinking candidate, not success
